author: Jagmeet Singh
title: WhatsApp's biggest market is becoming its toughest test | TechCrunch
description: Meta has three months to comply with Indian government directions that could affect how WhatsApp operates in the country.
content: WhatsApp, Meta’s messaging app that millions of Indians rely on daily, is facing a critical moment in India as recent government directions threaten to disrupt how the platform works for everyday use… [+6785 chars]
